ThingDef.label: archotech mnemocore
ThingDef.description: An archotech brain implant created by cannibalizing and adapting a persona core to fundamentally rearchitect an android's memory processing. Standard androids rely on finite hard drive space that gradually fills and requires periodic reformatting. The mnemocore replaces this architecture with self-organizing archotech substrate that never accumulates cruft.\n\nOnce installed, the android's memory need is eliminated entirely, RAM subroutines become unnecessary, and memory degradation ceases.
